normal: Search the web and return the top results with titles and snippets.
Read a wiki page structure for a GitHub repository. repoName must be in owner/repo format.
Ask a question about a repository and get an answer grounded in its documentation.
Get the current weather for a city. Units can be metric or imperial.
Create a calendar event with a title, start time and optional attendees.
List files in a directory. The path must be absolute.
Execute a read-only SQL query against the analytics database and return rows as JSON.
Send an email to the given recipient with a subject and plain-text body.
Transfer a file between two storage buckets in the same project.
Fetch the contents of a URL and convert HTML to markdown.
Translate text between languages. Always returns UTF-8.
Generate an image from a text prompt; returns a PNG URL.
Look up a stock quote by ticker symbol. Data may be delayed by 15 minutes.
Create a GitHub issue in the given repository with labels.
Summarize a PDF document. Large files are truncated to the first 100 pages.
Return the list of open pull requests, newest first.
Convert currencies using the latest daily exchange rates.
Run the project's unit tests and report failures.
Geocode an address into latitude and longitude.
Delete a draft by id. This cannot be undone.
